contract.protected_quantity: cumulative signed decrease of a fixed sealed audit potential; empirical version is compared with population endpoint improvement
contract.finite_panel_bound: on a uniform-deviation event over a pre-specified reachable class F, empirical cumulative progress <= true cumulative progress + 2*Delta
contract.horizon_semantics: no union bound over T is needed once the single uniform-deviation event covers every reachable endpoint in F
load_bearing_assumptions: trajectory endpoints remain in a class F with finite/useful uniform deviation
for the probabilistic finite-panel claim, sealed audit independence from adaptive training history
released feedback does not enlarge the effectively reachable class until the uniform bound becomes vacuous
does_not_guarantee: that every individual accepted edit is non-harmful
familywise probability of ever accepting a harmful intermediate edit
safety of an open-ended arbitrary-code/harness class when uniform convergence is vacuous
generic safety under repeated exact scalar release from a high-capacity reusable panel

mechanization_boundary.not_yet_proved_in_current_repo: AuditCP/AuditCP/FiniteExperts.lean explicitly leaves the finite-experts probability theorem and sealed-audit independence plumbing as TODO; the deterministic T2 therefore assumes UniformDev rather than deriving its high-probability event end-to-end.

adaptive_scalar_feedback_q8000_n200_20_s.implementation_scope_note: In current cp_experiments.py, fresh_subsample randomly selects half of the same reusable panel on each query rather than drawing new population examples; one_shot returns zero scalar feedback. Treat these as tested defenses in this synthetic attack, not generic reusable-holdout theorems.

self_improvement_design_implication: Use signed sealed-potential accounting as a global lineage-level anti-Goodhart ledger when the reachable class is complexity-controlled. Keep a separate candidate-local paired anytime-valid gate for individual promotion and a separate cross-candidate error-spending/multiple-testing contract if the objective is to bound ever accepting a harmful edit. Preserve a terminal outer test never used for proposal, promotion, rollback, retirement, early stopping or checkpoint selection.
scope_limits: ARC-TGI reward and holdout-attack experiments are synthetic/model-family-specific and do not establish general LLM-agent promotion safety.
The horizon-free 2*Delta result is powerful only when Delta is non-vacuous for the entire adaptively reachable class.
This artifact does not claim Audit-CP replaces PACE/SEA-style per-candidate certificates or global spending.
